description: Atomic facts on basil yield response to planting density and daily light integral, added 2026-11-26 for the validation fixes. Candidates until Ajit approves them (Batch 003). Reliability recorded per AGENTS.md 6A.

facts.statement: In a floating-raft greenhouse trial, basil at 317 plants/m2 yielded 4.81 kg/m2 against 3.66 kg/m2 at 159 plants/m2 (about 15 vs 23 g per plant).

review_metadata.confidence_reason: Direction corroborated by Walters and Currey 2015 (DFT spacing trial); magnitude single source at baby-leaf densities.

facts.statement: Basil shoot fresh weight rose 54, 79 and 78 percent at daily light integrals of 12.9, 16.5 and 17.8 mol/m2/d compared with 9.3, levelling off near 16.5; the authors suggest 12.9 for commercial production.

review_metadata.confidence_reason: Read from the abstract only; direction corroborated by Walters 2023, Litvin and Currey 2017, Walters and Currey 2015.

facts.statement: Basil fresh mass is far lower at a DLI of about 5.5 than at about 13 mol/m2/d (fitted model about 6 g vs 31 g per plant at 23 C), and higher temperature helps more at higher light.

review_metadata.confidence_reason: Values are our evaluation of a fitted regression (R2 0.63), not measured means.

facts.statement: In a floating-raft trial at 20 plants/m2, basil cut twice (35 and 79 days after planting) gave about 32 to 44 g fresh mass per plant per cut in aquaponics and about 38 g in hydroponics, i.e. roughly 0.65 to 0.89 kg/m2 per cut (our arithmetic).

context.system: floating raft, aquaponic and hydroponic, under 75 percent shade net

review_metadata.confidence_reason: Per-plant values read from Table 1; the 20 plants/m2 density came from a page summary, not verbatim; table means and abstract disagree slightly (41.7 vs 38.4 g); heavy shade, so light-limited.

facts.statement: In deep-flow hydroponics, basil 'Nufar' harvested once three weeks after transplant gained fresh mass per m2 as spacing went from 30 to 10 cm (+747 g/m2 at DLI 14 to 15, +489 g/m2 at DLI 5 to 6), while per-plant mass fell only slightly.

context.system: deep-flow technique, single harvest of young plants
context.densities: about 11 to 100 plants/m2 (square spacing, our arithmetic)
